package split // import "ubunatic.com/loom/examples/split/split"

Package split is experimental; its API may change between releases. See
docs/APIStability.md for the package stability policy.

Package split demonstrates nested split layout, divider dragging, and keyboard
focus traversal in loom.Split.

FUNCTIONS

func NewWidget(args []string) (loom.Widget, error)
    NewWidget builds the split example's root widget from command-line args,
    without creating or running a Pane.

func Run(args []string) error
    Run runs the split example with cobra command support.
